messages:
ashok: Quick heads-up — starting a permission sunset run in the next access-review window. Goal: remove stale org-admin roles and orphan KMS bindings. Will post evidence artifacts.

maria: thanks. what's the scope? org-wide or just prod projects?

ashok: prod-only to start: proj-*prod, kms keys in us-west1. Target list = owners/admins who haven't claimed ownership in 180 days.

julie: can we get an auditor CSV export? I can kick off the entitlement-extractor job. Command:
```
./entitlement-extractor --projects proj-prod* --days-since-last-active 180 --out /tmp/prod_orphans.csv
```

ashok: perfect. include principal_type and last_auth_ts columns. add kms_bindings column (comma-separated).

maria: @julie add me as reviewer on the CSV. i'll filter by business-critical services and raise exceptions.

sec-bot: Audit job scheduled by julie at 2026-03-21T16:32:10Z. Output: /artifacts/prod_orphans.csv

julie: uploaded CSV to drive: https://confluence.company/internal/access-reviews/prod_orphans.csv

tom: quick Q: KMS binding cleanups — do we need to modify IAM policies or rotate keys first? Security prefers rotation before removal if binding is still used.

ashok: agreed. plan: for any binding tied to service accounts with active tokens, we'll rotate keys (KMS key version rotate) and then remove admin grants. For orphaned human admins, remove binding immediately after 7-day notice.

maria: can someone draft the notice? short message + link to "how to appeal" playbook. I can send from security@redwood.

julie: draft in thread, plz review:
"You are listed as an org-admin on proj-XYZ; no recent activity seen. Please respond within 7 days or your admin entitlement will be removed. Appeal: https://confluence.company/internal/access-reviews/appeal"

tom: LGTM :thumbsup:

ashok: tagging deploy runbook — removal steps:
1) verify principal last_auth_ts
2) comment on CSV with decision
3) run `gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding ...` or `terraform apply` if infra managed
4) rotate KMS key where applicable
5) record audit ticket

maria: small gotcha — some teams use temporary workspace tokens; we'll add an 'exceptions_pending' label to track.

julie: starting remediation batch 1 now. Will post logs to #eng-security-ops.

ashok: thanks. set reminder for re-review in 30d. :eyes: 

sec-bot: Evidence bundle created: s3://redwood-audit-bundles/2026-03-21/2512346789-evidence.zip
